verdict.rationale: Official docs show a first-party CLI, firectl, being used to deploy a LoRA-trained model with a single command (`firectl deployment create ...`), which confirms an official CLI exists. That is the only mention, and it covers just one deployment workflow. Missing for 10: documentation of the CLI's install, auth and full command coverage (training, batch, inference, model upload), any agent- or automation-oriented features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
